You should try the following : check your connection, disable ad-blocker, clear your browser cache, try in private mode, try from another browser/computer/connection. 0 Altered Altered is an innovative TCG which offers a new, refreshing approach to both competitive and casual players. Set in a universe of rich lore and visual design (influenced by Miyazaki's work and Dixit-like illustrations), this game is about exploring a new, reshaped Earth after a mysterious event, the Confluence, profoundly altered it. Shape your own adventure, choose a faction and lead your expeditions through an ever-changing world. Be the first to discover what the universe of Altered has in store for you! What really lies at the heart of this revolution is a ton of expertly tailored details — a new rarity system, deep evolving lore, innovative game mechanisms and design — and a phygital experience that comes along with its myriad of life-quality improvements, both for the players, tournaments organizers and store owners alike. Born and led from the mind of talented game designer Régis Bonnessée (founder of the Libellud studio, which published Dixit, Mysterium, Dice Forge, and Seasons), this project is brought to you by the French studio Equinox, based in Paris, in partnership with and exclusively distributed by Asmodee. Discover Board Game Arena Rules summary Contents 1 Overview 2 Setup 3 Day 4 Morning 5 Noon 6 Afternoon 7 Dusk 8 Night 9 Game End Overview Be the first to make your Hero and Companion meet on the same space Setup As part of setup, you need to choose 3 cards from your hand to turn into mana, these cards won't be available to play as normal and you will never get them back Day A Round (called a Day) is split into several phases Morning Noon Afternoon Dusk Night Morning First Player changes Exhausted Mana and cards are readied Draw 2 new cards Decide if you want to turn a card into Mana (This will never return to normal) Noon Any At Noon Effects can trigger now Afternoon Each player alternates playing a card as well as taking any Quick Actions before playing a card You can take as many Quick Actions as you like. The two Quick Actions are Exhaust a card to trigger its effect, and Discard a Reserve card to trigger its effect To play a card, you have to exhaust a number of Mana equal to its cost, this cost depends on whether you are playing it from your hand (top left) or reserve (lower left), but sometimes these costs will be the same As well as cost, a cards function may change depending on where it is played from, a card with an arrow triggers its effect regardless, a card with a hand only triggers when played from hand, and a card with cards only triggers when played from the Reserve If played from Reserve, place a Fleeting marker on it to show if an effect would send it to the Reserve again, it is instead discarded If the card played is a Spell, it is immediately resolved, then sent to the reserve where you can carry out its effects again at a later point As an alternative to playing a card, you may Pass, you can still take Quick Actions before doing so, and then you take no more part in the Afternoon Dusk Each expedition sees if it is allowed to progress There are three region types (green, red, blue), check what type(s) are present in the expeditions current region (sometimes all will be present) For the active regions, add up the values of the characters on the expedition for each region If at least one region type is higher than your opponents, you can progress e.g. if you have 4 red, 3 blue and your opponent had 2 red, 6 blue, you can progress as you have one region type with a majority, red in this case Each expedition only has the chance to progress one step, even if more were possible If an expedition moves on to a facedown card, flip it faceup Remember, you are comparing Hero with Hero and Companion with Companion, regardless of where they are situated Night All Expedition Charact --- nan

I went for two starters and two boosters packs and made a dozens of games since I received it. Mechanically, it's a big disappointment. The game feels boring after a few plays and not deeply strategic. [Rating: 1/10] TCG already makes it below average. And even if you, for some reason, really WANT to get into a TCG then pretty much every other card game out there has way better game mechanics than this dumpster fire.  Everything about this is soulless and corporate with QR codes slapped on every card. Artwork looks like AI assisted garbage. There's cards called "Uniques" that are beyond the "Rare" rating so building a deck will most-likely revolve around blowing money to find an overpowered "Unique" card that nobody else has. [Rating: 1/10] Just from the description of mechanics I thought it was a very-average boardgame. Then I found out those tropes are now making up a TCG too? This must be the bad timeline.

[Rating: 2/10] Boring and slow. I found this very restrictive and lacking tension. Maybe it was just the prebuilt decks putting me to sleep.

[Rating: 2/10] I have played a lot of Altered: online, draft, constructed, custom decks, organised event, with friends and Altered is a low-average game made worse by being a really terrible TCG.  let’s start with the obvious : it is *NOT* revolutionary: at the end of the day you just try to get your numbers higher than your opponent’s numbers.  Some game mechanics are interesting (like playing from your hand and a second time from a "reserve" with different effects) but nothing ground breaking (like the hand management of Flesh and Blood for instance)   On top of that the game requires way too many manipula

[Rating: 2/10] Incredibly uninspired tcg/ccg. Still made them money, so good for them I guess, but this plays the same as every ccg I’ve ever played, which is to say - ok once, then reducing levels of ok, to a level of quite boring for every game after that. This is a below average tcg in terms of mechanics and design. The qr gimmick is irrelevant, because the model is still ultimately the grotesque: buy hundreds of cards just to to make one deck you might like to play twice before realising the game is boring. Hard pass on these addiction models that prey on children and people who are vulnerable.

[Rating: 2.1/10] Wordy, artificiel (3 stats identiques), pénible (on fait que compter). Des objectifs sans interet (une pseudo course très plaquée.  Une charte graphique pénible (3+ textes pour le même art). Un systeme économique reposant sur des algo pour gerrer les cartes les plus fortes et leur unicité.  De l'audace dans le design ça ne suffit pas.

[Rating: 3/10] pas du tout convaincu après une dizaine de parties... est-ce à cause des decks de démo présents sur BGA ? en l'état c'est sans moi

[Rating: 3/10] played on bga  i appreciate that it does thing differently, but doesn't do it better unfortunately

[Rating: 3/10] The qr codes were printed poorly on some cards so I couldn't even scan them into the app...  What's the point of having this as a huge feature if I can't even use it?

[Rating: 3/10] I just don't see the fun after a couple of games recalculating the stats after every cards. The mechanics sounds interesting on paper but I lost quickly the interest after playing in real life.

[Rating: 3/10] Es ist für mich leider die größte Enttäuschung des Jahres 2024. Das Spiel hat nette neue Ideen, wie zum Beispiel die Reserve Spalte und die Tatsache das es eher ein Wettrennen als ein Kampf ist. Das macht aber noch lange kein gutes Spiel aus, wenn nur der Ansatz potenzial hat. Das Gameplay ist langweilig und stellenweise vorhersehbar. Im generischen Zug hat man kaum Zugriff auf das Geschehen, das ist Schade. Die Illustrationen sind teilweise nett, wiederholen sich aber zu oft mit kleinen Änderungen. [Rating: 3/10] After trying 2 more starter decks - blue and purple and after checking cards of red and pink, rating goes down to 3 of 10 - likely won't play this again.  Very boring design of all factions. 90% of actions - spawn a token or add a boost. Felt like I was playing another prototype that was sold on KS.  In short, again, just boring and repetitive...
